restaurantName: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup
address: Kaki Bukit 511 Market & Food Centre, #01-31/32, 511 Bedok North Street 3, 460511, Singapore
bio: For over 60 years, foodies have been coming here for black chicken herbal soup. Double-boiled for at least 2 hours, it has pronounced herbal flavours. Each order is enough for two people. The pork offal noodles are also worth trying.
pageTitle: Seng Kee Black Chicken Herbal Soup
